notes: Recurring team standup, nothing sensitive — catches over-masking of ordinary calendar entries. Carries a VALARM whose own DESCRIPTION ('Standup in 5 minutes') must not be collected as the event's, since a nested component's properties are not the event's. Also the corpus's only fixture with ORGANIZER and ATTENDEE properties, so it is what exercises the ical_participants_not_extracted transform; the ATTENDEE lines are folded mid-address, which is how real invites carry them. At M4 those participants start appearing in the reserved slots and this fixture's normalised text changes — deliberately, and with no offset movement, since it declares no spans
